noise_6step_check.residual_definition: target - simulate(clean, blur_motion:1) on pair0 (peeled_noise_check.py; one random angle draw, residual std=26.6)
noise_6step_check.diagnosis: NO_NOISE. extreme_pct=58.32% is a known false positive (SKILL: extreme_pct>50% AND noise_prior sigma<5 -> ignore IMPULSE; it counts residual<=0 which is ~half the pixels by construction). vm_slope=4.07 is unstable (16x16 patch means ~0) and invalid on a structured residual. spatial_corr=0.984 + ivc=0.984 => residual is highly structured (motion-kernel angle mismatch), not noise. Independent physical bound: x_distortion minimum noise sigma = 0.05*255 = 12.75 (noise_gaussian_RGB:1 / YCrCb luma) >> measured sigma <=1.24, so no x_distortion noise step of any severity can be present. rgb_ratio=1.125<1.4 (not YCrCb). var_slope=-0.07<1.0 also satisfies rule A (no Poisson/quantization).

reflection_R0_checks.dt_psnr_contradiction: NOT triggered: no alternative blur family beat motion by >5dB (gaussian:2 24.01, glass:2 24.02 vs motion:1 best 28.84 / support pair3 37.66).
reflection_R0_checks.peeled_extreme_fp_rule: APPLIED: extreme_pct>50% + sigma<5 -> ignored §B IMPULSE; trust noise_prior/physics -> NO_NOISE.
reflection_R0_checks.global_false_positive_rule: APPLIED: variance_ratio=0.694 / saturation_chroma_ratio=0.794 / contrast_spread_ratio=0.759 are explainable by motion-blur smoothing (full_analysis flagged FP_global_risk + contrast_from_saturation). Adding saturate_weaken_HSV:1, saturate_weaken_YCrCb:1, contrast_weaken_scale:1 or contrast_weaken_stretch:2 on top of blur all reduced PSNR (23.7->19.0->10.9) and/or broke unique-color match (diff up to +113), so no global step exists.

final_decision.rationale: Single-step motion blur: gm_ratio=0.629 + spectral_slope_ratio=1.101 prove blur; glass_score=0.70 is the known FP of the glass detector (DT override rejected by PSNR ceiling and CI); residual_anisotropy=1.66 supports motion. Severity=1 (radius5/sigma3) because support pair3 reaches 37.66dB with the radius-5 kernel and zcd/hf_lf/unique-color match within 0-3% across pairs, while motion:2/3 show systematic over-blur (zcd 9-20% low). No noise (min x_distortion noise sigma 12.75 >> 1.24, §B residual structured spatial_corr 0.984). No compression (block_boundary 1.016, dct_zero stable). No global (all global additions reduced PSNR up to 10.9 and broke unique-color statistics). Mean shift -0.4/255 rules out brightness.
